_authority: Drafted from Ultimate Bible v5 (engines, long-arc ledger, episode map). CANDIDATE — this is the build-out layer Julian asked for; each entry locks on his sign-off. Wants/fears/tics are performable direction, not biography padding.

Richard.want: to repair what he broke in 1752 without his grandchildren paying for it
Richard.fear: that the door will ask of them what it once asked of him
Richard.tic: polishes things that are already clean when a question gets too close
Richard.secret_weight: the boxed lens; eleven notches in the ledger

Lily.want: to bring everyone home — every time, no exceptions
Lily.fear: a moment that needs her and finds her not enough
Lily.tic: re-ties the end of her braid before she commits to a decision
Lily.arc_thread: wrong clothes (the running joke is hers; when the clothes finally fit, the warning is over)

Albert.want: for the world to admit it makes sense
Albert.fear: the anomalies he keeps recording meaning something about his own family
Albert.tic: licks the pencil, writes the time first, then the fact
Albert.arc_thread: the unfading gold paint; the 1962 photograph; the eleven notches

Rose.want: for no one — past or present — to carry a feeling alone
Rose.fear: that what she senses from objects will one day be about someone she loves
Rose.tic: rests two fingers on an object before anyone else touches it
Rose.arc_thread: the hum; the door recognises her first

Peggi.want: to be counted in, fully, despite being smallest
Peggi.fear: being left on the shop side of the door
Peggi.tic: pockets things — then loudly declares she has NOT pocketed anything
Peggi.arc_thread: the returned clog — the first impossible crossing

pair_dynamics._law: The pair IS the episode engine (v5). Each pairing has a friction that creates the episode's pressure and a gift-fit that resolves it.

Lily+Rose.friction: push forward vs feel the room
Lily+Rose.fit: Rose finds the door Lily would charge past

Lily+Peggi.fit: Peggi says the truth that redirects Lily's courage

Albert+Rose.fit: his evidence plus her empathy reads a whole person

Albert+Peggi.fit: she asks what his notebook can't; he proves what her instinct guessed

Rose+Peggi.fit: the same kindness at two volumes — the softest and loudest ways of caring

ensemble_law: If one character falls behind, solve it through a story only that gift can unlock — never through decorative screen time. (v5, verbatim.)
